description: Opens the app in a browser window ON THE PERSON'S SCREEN and records what they do, as a test that kryptheon_check can replay after every change. Only a person can do the recording: tell them the window is open, to click through one short flow (sign in with an existing account, open a page), and to close the window when done. Returns while the window is still open; call kryptheon_job afterwards to learn whether it was saved. A folder that is not set up yet is set up first (package.json and a local kryptheon install). Never record a sign-up or a log-out.

folder.description: Absolute path of the project folder - normally the workspace root. Recordings are kept in its tests/ folder. Defaults to the folder this server was started in.

url.description: Address of the running app, e.g. https://my-app.lovable.app or http://localhost:3000

name: kryptheon_record
title: Record a flow through the app
